MOVEMENT AND CREATIVE ACTIVITIES — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #11
====

GRADE: Grade 3
SUBJECT: MOVEMENT AND CREATIVE ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Best practice when working on Musical Instruments: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Musical Instruments.
   B. Practise Musical Instruments with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Musical Instruments.
   D. Damage equipment used for Musical Instruments.

2. Best practice when working on Songs: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Songs.
   B. Practise Songs with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Songs.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Songs.

3. Best practice when working on Elements of AND RESPONDING: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Elements of AND RESPONDING.
   B. Practise Elements of AND RESPONDING with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Elements of AND RESPONDING.
   D. Damage equipment used for Elements of AND RESPONDING.

4. Best practice when working on Rhythm COMPOSING: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Rhythm COMPOSING.
   B. Practise Rhythm COMPOSING with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Rhythm COMPOSING.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Rhythm COMPOSING.

5. In music, tempo refers to: (1 mark)
   A. Only the volume
   B. The ticket price
   C. Only the costume
   D. The speed of the music

6. Warming up before sport helps to: (1 mark)
   A. Guarantee a trophy
   B. Remove the need for rules
   C. Replace drinking water
   D. Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk

7. Best practice when working on Singing games: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Singing games.
   B. Practise Singing games with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Singing games.
   D. Damage equipment used for Singing games.

8. Primary colours are: (1 mark)
   A. Black, white, and grey
   B. Brown, pink, and gold
   C. Red, blue, and yellow
   D. Green, orange, and purple

9. Best practice when working on Melody: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Melody.
   B. Damage equipment used for Melody.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Melody.
   D. Practise Melody with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

10. Best practice when working on Dance: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Dance.
   B. Practise Dance with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Dance.
   D. Damage equipment used for Dance.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
11. In three clear sentences, explain Dance and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

12. In three clear sentences, explain Rhythm COMPOSING and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

13. In three clear sentences, explain Melody and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Elements of AND RESPONDING and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Songs and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain Musical Instruments and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Dance and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Rhythm COMPOSING and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Melody and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
